data.one_liner: Scan QR codes and barcodes within the widget tree and decode images from file paths.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ScanView widget to scan QR codes and barcodes directly from the camera feed with custom styling options. Also allows decoding QR codes and barcodes from image file paths programmatically.
use_when: You need to embed a QR or barcode scanner inside a custom widget layout.
You need to decode QR or barcode data from an existing image path on the device.
avoid_when: You want to generate QR code images (use qr_flutter instead).
strengths: Customizable scan area scale and scan line colors.
Supports decoding barcodes and QR codes from image paths.
Includes torch toggle and pause/resume controller functions.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for camera usage on iOS and Android.
Limited to scanning and parsing functionalities.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSCameraUsageDescription and io.flutter.embedded_views_preview to iOS Info.plist, and the CAMERA permission to the Android Manifest.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative package for scanning QR codes and barcodes from the camera.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative solution using Google ML Kit for on-device barcode and QR code scanning.
